name: Gaia DR3 bounded bright-source catalogue

source.query: SELECT TOP 10000 source_id,ref_epoch,ra,dec,parallax,parallax_error,phot_g_mean_mag,bp_rp FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 7.5 ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC

storage.id: uint64; never route via floating point

distancePolicy: No distance estimates. Missing fields store finite zero with presence flag unset, never an invented value or NaN. Negative source parallaxes are preserved.
displayPolicy: Unit-sphere direction projection, no inferred stellar distance. Halos and color mapping are display transforms, not measured extent or calibrated spectrum.
limitations: Exactly 10000 retained sources, with no completeness claim; Gaia can omit very bright stars.
Coordinates remain at epoch J2016.0, without proper-motion propagation, aberration, location or extinction correction.
No temperature is inferred from BP-RP. This catalogue does not represent the entire universe.
attribution: ESA/Gaia/DPAC. Uses ESA Gaia mission data processed by the Gaia Data Processing and Analysis Consortium (DPAC). DPAC funding is supplied by national institutions participating in the Gaia Multilateral Agreement.
